mentions.name: ReMapper
mentions.description: This open source hardware and software dongle translates HID input to HID output using Lua scripts. In programming mode it functions as a flash drive for loading Lua scripts; in run mode it executes a selected script, enabling use cases such as keyboard-to-joystick mapping, key logging, macros, and mouse wiggling. Currently supports 1 input and 1 output, with plans for multiple inputs in a future iteration.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making an HID translation dongle.

In programming mode, its a flash drive you can put LUA scripts on.

In run mode, you can select a lua script to run. Lua scripts can take HID input and produce HID output.

All open source, hardware and software: https://github.com/cedarhacks/ReMapper
